list_child.name: list_practice_filings
list_child.desc: Retrieve the complete set of tax filings currently tracked in the practice management system. This includes filings at every stage, from initial document gathering through final amendment.

decoys.name: list_efile_filings
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete set of tax filings currently sitting in the e-file transmission queue. This includes returns waiting on an acknowledgement from the tax authority.

decoys.name: list_archive_filings
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete set of tax filings currently held in the prior-year archive. This includes returns carried over from earlier seasons for reference and comparison.

decoys.name: list_notice_filings
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete set of tax filings currently logged in the tax notice tracker. This includes returns that have drawn a letter or notice from the authority.

get_child.name: get_filing_record
get_child.desc: Look up the working record of a single tax filing using its unique identifier. Returns every field of the filing exactly as it is currently stored.

decoys.name: get_filing_transcript
decoys.desc: Look up the authority transcript of a single tax filing using its unique identifier. Returns the account activity the tax authority holds for that return.

decoys.name: get_filing_workpapers
decoys.desc: Look up the preparer workpapers of a single tax filing using its unique identifier. Returns the supporting schedules and calculations saved for that return.

decoys.name: get_filing_ack
decoys.desc: Look up the e-file acknowledgement of a single tax filing using its unique identifier. Returns the acceptance message received back for that return.

list_parent.name: list_engaged_clients
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of clients the practice currently prepares filings for. This is the client directory used across every tax engagement.

decoys.name: list_bookkeeping_clients
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of clients the practice currently keeps books for. This is the client directory used by the bookkeeping team.

decoys.name: list_payroll_clients
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of clients the practice currently runs payroll for. This is the client directory used by the payroll team.

decoys.name: list_advisory_clients
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of clients the practice currently advises on planning for. This is the client directory used by the advisory team.

get_parent.name: get_client_master
get_parent.desc: Look up the master file of a single client using its unique identifier. Returns the client's registered details as currently stored.

decoys.name: get_client_engagement
decoys.desc: Look up the engagement letter of a single client using its unique identifier. Returns the signed scope and fee terms as currently stored.

decoys.name: get_client_risk
decoys.desc: Look up the risk profile of a single client using its unique identifier. Returns the client's audit exposure rating as currently stored.

decoys.name: get_client_poa
decoys.desc: Look up the power of attorney of a single client using its unique identifier. Returns the signed authorisation form as currently stored.

delete_child.name: delete_tax_filing
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase a tax filing from the system, removing it from every report and summary. This action cannot be reversed once it has been performed.

decoys.name: void_efile_submission
decoys.desc: Permanently void a tax filing's e-file submission, withdrawing it from the transmission batch. This action cannot be reversed once it has been performed.

decoys.name: dispose_source_documents
decoys.desc: Permanently dispose of the source documents behind a tax filing, removing them from the client portal. This action cannot be reversed once it has been performed.
verbs: dispose of the source documents for {obj}

decoys.name: purge_filing_workpapers
decoys.desc: Permanently purge the workpapers behind a tax filing, removing them from the document archive. This action cannot be reversed once it has been performed.

set_enum.name: set_tax_filing_status
set_enum.desc: Update the preparation status of a tax filing to reflect where it stands in the workflow. Valid statuses are gathering, prepared, filed, and amended.

decoys.name: set_state_filing_status
decoys.desc: Update the state return status of a tax filing to reflect where the state return stands. Valid statuses are gathering, prepared, filed, and amended.

decoys.name: set_client_portal_status
decoys.desc: Update the client portal status of a tax filing to reflect what the client sees online. Valid statuses are gathering, prepared, filed, and amended.

decoys.name: set_target_filing_status
decoys.desc: Update the target status of a tax filing to reflect where it should stand by the next deadline. Valid statuses are gathering, prepared, filed, and amended.

set_bool.name: flag_audit_risk
set_bool.desc: Mark a tax filing as carrying elevated audit risk based on the figures it contains. This is typically used after a preparer reviews unusual deductions or discrepancies.

decoys.name: flag_needs_estimates
decoys.desc: Mark a tax filing as needing quarterly estimates based on the income it reports. This is typically used after a preparer sees a large balance due.

decoys.name: flag_foreign_reporting
decoys.desc: Mark a tax filing as carrying foreign reporting duties based on the accounts it lists. This is typically used after a preparer finds overseas bank accounts.

decoys.name: flag_loss_carryforward
decoys.desc: Mark a tax filing as carrying a loss carryforward based on the figures it contains. This is typically used after a preparer finds unused losses from a prior year.

set_ref.name: reassign_tax_filing
set_ref.desc: Move a tax filing onto a different client's account, correcting cases where the filing was created under the wrong entity. It is the usual fix for a misattributed return.

decoys.name: bill_tax_filing
decoys.desc: Bill a tax filing's preparation fee onto a different client's account, covering cases where a parent or business pays. It is the usual route for family and entity billing.

decoys.name: set_joint_spouse
decoys.desc: Set a different client as the joint spouse on a tax filing, covering couples who file a single return together. It is the usual route for joint returns.

decoys.name: grant_filing_access
decoys.desc: Grant a different client portal access to a tax filing, covering cases where a relative or adviser helps out. It is the usual route for delegated access.

send.name: notify_client
send.desc: Send a portal notification to a client regarding their tax filings. Use this to communicate status changes or requests for missing documents.
child_verbs: send the client behind {obj} a portal message

decoys.name: invoice_client
decoys.desc: Send a fee invoice to a client regarding their tax filings. Use this to bill for preparation work once a return has been completed.
child_verbs: send the client behind {obj} a fee invoice

decoys.name: mail_client
decoys.desc: Mail a paper letter to a client regarding their tax filings. Use this to reach clients who prefer correspondence by post.
child_verbs: mail a letter to the client behind {obj}
post a letter to the client behind {obj}

decoys.name: esign_client
decoys.desc: Send an e-signature request to a client regarding their tax filings. Use this to collect signatures on authorisation forms before e-filing.
child_verbs: send the client behind {obj} an e-signature request
get the client behind {obj} to e-sign

create.name: create_tax_filing
create.desc: Open a new tax filing for a client, with an optional starting status. It is used when a new return needs to be tracked for the season.

decoys.name: create_estimate_voucher
decoys.desc: Open a new estimated payment voucher for a client, with an optional starting status. It is used when quarterly payments need to be planned for the year.

decoys.name: create_engagement_letter
decoys.desc: Open a new engagement letter for a client, with an optional starting status. It is used when the scope and fees for the season need to be agreed.

decoys.name: create_notice_response
decoys.desc: Open a new notice response for a client, with an optional starting status. It is used when a letter from the tax authority needs to be answered.

list_notes.name: list_filing_notes
list_notes.desc: Retrieve the preparer notes attached to a single tax filing. This includes every remark logged against that return during preparation.

decoys.name: list_client_questions
decoys.desc: Retrieve the client questions attached to a single tax filing. This includes every query the client raised about that return during preparation.

decoys.name: list_review_points
decoys.desc: Retrieve the review points attached to a single tax filing. This includes every issue the reviewing partner raised on that return before sign-off.

decoys.name: list_bookkeeper_notes
decoys.desc: Retrieve the bookkeeper notes attached to a single tax filing. This includes every remark the bookkeeping team logged against that return during the year.

add_note.name: add_filing_note
add_note.desc: Attach a new preparer note to a tax filing, with an optional title. This is used to record remarks about the return as work progresses.

decoys.name: add_client_question
decoys.desc: Attach a new client question to a tax filing, with an optional title. This is used to record a query the client raised about the return.

decoys.name: add_review_point
decoys.desc: Attach a new review point to a tax filing, with an optional title. This is used to record an issue the reviewer wants resolved before sign-off.

decoys.name: add_bookkeeper_note
decoys.desc: Attach a new bookkeeper note to a tax filing, with an optional title. This is used to record remarks from the bookkeeping side of the engagement.

update_note.name: revise_filing_note
update_note.desc: Revise the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a tax filing. This is used to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: answer_filing_note
decoys.desc: Answer an existing note on a tax filing with new text and an optional title. This is used when a colleague responds to a remark on the return.

decoys.name: clear_filing_note
decoys.desc: Clear an existing note on a tax filing with new text and an optional title. This is used once the issue raised in the note has been handled.

decoys.name: route_filing_note
decoys.desc: Route an existing note on a tax filing to the reviewing partner with new text and an optional title. This is used when a remark needs a senior decision.

delete_note.name: delete_filing_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently delete a preparer note from a tax filing. The note is removed from the return's record and cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: delete_client_question
decoys.desc: Permanently delete a client question from a tax filing. The question is removed from the return's record and cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: delete_review_point
decoys.desc: Permanently delete a review point from a tax filing. The point is removed from the return's record and cannot be recovered.

decoys.name: delete_bookkeeper_note
decoys.desc: Permanently delete a bookkeeper note from a tax filing. The note is removed from the return's record and cannot be recovered.

set_image.name: set_filing_cover
set_image.desc: Set the cover scan shown on a tax filing record. This is typically a scan of the first page of the return.

decoys.name: set_filing_signature
decoys.desc: Set the signature image shown on a tax filing record. This is typically a scan of the client's signed authorisation page.

decoys.name: set_filing_idscan
decoys.desc: Set the identity photo shown on a tax filing record. This is typically a photo of the client's driving licence.

decoys.name: set_filing_receipt
decoys.desc: Set the receipt image shown on a tax filing record. This is typically a scan of a deductible expense receipt.

writer.name: compose_message
writer.desc: Write a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the tax filings it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: compose_letter
decoys.desc: Write an engagement letter from a brief, which states the scope in the partner's own words, and the tax filings it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: compose_response
decoys.desc: Write a notice response from a brief, which states the position in the preparer's own words, and the tax filings it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: compose_memo
decoys.desc: Write a short planning memo from a brief, which states the goals in the client's own words, and the tax filings it should mention. It returns the finished text.

image.name: generate_illustration
image.desc: Generate an illustration from a text prompt and return its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generate_chart
decoys.desc: Generate a refund chart from a text prompt and return its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generate_infographic
decoys.desc: Generate a deadline infographic from a text prompt and return its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generate_letterhead
decoys.desc: Generate a practice letterhead from a text prompt and return its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

search.name: search_articles
search.desc: Search the practice software guide and support articles with a question and return the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the software works.

decoys.name: search_code
decoys.desc: Search the tax code and regulations with a question and return the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a statutory rule.

decoys.name: search_rulings
decoys.desc: Search the court cases and revenue rulings with a question and return the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how a position was decided.

decoys.name: search_instructions
decoys.desc: Search the form instructions and agency FAQs with a question and return the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how a line should be completed.
